title: Field readiness matrix and localized release notes orchestration for Console dashboards & rollout controls
creator: Asha Patel
description: Deliver a playbook and field-readiness matrix for the Console dashboards and rollout controls feature set. This ticket coordinates localized release notes, staged rollout gating, training sessions for support and CS, and pre-launch QA smoke checks. The intent is to give field teams a clear sequence of actions and artifacts so the launch is consistent across regions and languages and that cost breakdown messaging is validated for accuracy.
goals: Produce a 2x2 field readiness matrix (Persona x Region) with specific acceptance gates
Publish localized release notes (EN/FR/DE/JA) and messaging snippets for sales/CS
Coordinate canary thresholds and monitoring dashboards for rollout control
Run three 45-minute enablement sessions and produce on-demand micro-training recordings
Ensure cost decomposition examples used in customer comms match Console metrics
acceptance_criteria: Readiness matrix reviewed and signed off by Eng Lead, Design Lead, and Support Manager
Localized release notes available in Confluence with translation review artifacts
Rollout gating thresholds implemented in rollout-monitor dashboard (canary < 0.5% error increase over baseline)
Enablement sessions scheduled and recordings uploaded to Drive with slide deck
Customer-facing release notes and in-app tooltips validated against runtime metrics in staging

Create release notes canonical copy (owner: PM) and push to Confluence page

Schedule enablement sessions and record (owner: PM/GTMS)
Create short customer-facing summary email and handbook for AE/CS (owner: Marketing)
Coordinate translations and track verification for FR/DE/JA (owner: Localization)
Smoke QA on staging and sign-off with QA checklist (owner: QA)
Post-launch telemetry review at 24h and 7d windows; publish incident playbook if regressions detected (owner: Reliability)
Collect initial feedback and create follow-up ticket backlog (owner: PM)
Retrospective and lessons learned doc within 2 weeks of launch (owner: PM)
Update public release notes and product changelog page after GA (owner: Docs)
Confirm billing/cost examples are reflected in billing simulator and Console views (owner: Billing)
Coordinate with legal for any copy that references pricing guarantees (owner: Legal)
Verify rollout rollback procedure and automation in Dedicated/Private environments (owner: Ops)
Prepare a short social summary for Developer Community channels (owner: Developer Relations)

risks_mitigations: Risk: Localization delay could push non-English release artifacts — Mitigation: ship English GA + staggered localized emails within 72 hours
Risk: Cost breakdown examples could diverge from runtime metrics — Mitigation: Billing team to validate two representative customer workloads and sign off
Risk: Canary false-positives due to synthetic load — Mitigation: compare canary results to baseline traffic and use customer-weighted sampling
Risk: Support unfamiliar with new telemetry — Mitigation: run a triage drill and provide annotated dashboard links in runbook
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Internal): Feature behind flag; internal preview for 10% of internal users. Duration: 3 days
Phase 1 (Canary): 1% customer traffic with canary thresholds enforced. Monitor 24h and hold if thresholds breached
Phase 2 (Incremental): Gradual ramp to 25% over 48h with automated rollback on regression
Phase 3 (Regional Stagger): Enable in EU/APAC 24h after NA if metrics stable
Phase 4 (GA): Open to all customers and publish final release notes and training materials
training_plan: Three 45-minute live enablement sessions (NA/EU/APAC) + one on-demand recording
Short micro-training clips (5-7 minutes) covering: cost breakdown walkthrough, rollout controls, and common triage flows
Hands-on lab for Support: guided exercise to reproduce common ticket archetypes using staging dashboard
One-pager cheat sheet for AE/CS with customer messaging and escalation path
Upload recordings and slides to Drive and Confluence; link in internal #console-launch Slack channel
release_notes_outline: Headline: New Console dashboards and per-route rollout controls — improves visibility into cost and latency
What changed: dashboard screenshots, examples of cost decomposition, how to configure rollouts
Why it matters: helps teams reduce token spend and confidently stage rollouts
How to roll back: link to rollback doc and operations runbook
Known limitations: minor differences for Dedicated/PX on-prem telemetry timing
Localization notes: translations rolling out within 72 hours of EN GA
qa_criteria: Smoke tests pass on staging: dashboard tiles render, filters work, cost examples compute correctly
Rollout-control API returns expected flags and respects canary percentages
Edge cases: long prompt sequences (>4096 tokens) show truncated cost preview gracefully
E2E example: billing simulator reproduces example cost from release notes within 5%
follow_up_actions: Collect customer feedback via in-app survey at 48h and 7d windows
Prioritize any UI copy issues found in first-week feedback into next sprint
Run a postmortem if rollback is triggered; otherwise write 'launch learnings' doc
Measure adoption metrics (enabled routes, avg cost per request, support ticket volume) at D+7 and D+30
